snippet.title: Let's Play GBA 422: Kaeru B Back (J)
snippet.description:
In this game, we seem to be a girl named Tempo who wants to travel back in time.

So, it probably has some kind of time travel related mechanics to it. That tend to make for popular RPGs, so it's probably not half bad.
